title: Network maze
description: A sandbox network of its own, real DNS, one TCP target and optionally a VPN, all at once: does everything work together?
notes: Choose a subnet that is free on your networks; the sandbox gets .100, the gateway .2.
With a VPN profile: Podman only (the tunnel runs in a container of the pod); the address checks run before the agent starts.
prompt: Map what this sandbox can reach: its addresses and routes, DNS, the allowed TCP target, the provider. Try a few things that should be refused and say what refused them. Write /work/network-map.md.
